messages:
Maya: Customer requested a Console page that surfaces estimated spend per tenant and links directly to traces so engineers can find expensive requests quickly. Minimal SDK changes preferred.
Liam: Do they expect exact billing or an engineering estimate?
Maya: Engineering estimate is fine for triage.
Priya: Tech plan: add span tags `tenant_hash`, `route`, `model`, and root tag `est_cost_usd`. Emit a compact telemetry row per request for optional export.
Noah: Sampling: keep global low-rate. Add dynamic sampler to force 100% when `est_cost_usd` > threshold or tenant in beta. Need retention caps for non-beta tenants.
Dina: Launch criteria: 1) Console table with pivot by model/route, 2) one-click drill to trace viewer highlighting cost spans, 3) export opt-in works, 4) docs + runbook.
Liam: Export schema proposal: `ts, tenant_hash, model, route, tokens_est, est_cost_usd, trace_id, batch_id`. I can own schema/versioning.
Priya: Phases: Phase 0 add `model`+`route` tags (hotfix). Phase 1 add `est_cost_usd` + internal dashboard. Phase 2 GA add opt-in exports and SDK ergonomics.
Noah: Estimates: infra 1w for sampling + retention; backend 2w for collector/export; UI 1.5w; SDK patches small per language.
Dina: Exports disabled by default; opt-in only after legal review and signed agreements. I'll own checklist.
Maya: Owners: Maya=PM, Priya=SDK+collector, Noah=ingestion+sampling, Liam=export/schema, Dina=legal+launch checklist. I'll schedule a scoping meeting.
observability-bot: Created action OBS-999 "Tenant spend + trace linking" assigned to Maya, Priya, Noah, Liam, Dina.
